verdict.rationale: The evidence documents API-key and OAuth 2.0 M2M authentication and IP allowlisting. None of it says credentials can be scoped or made read-only so that a holder can read analytics but cannot send. Authentication methods and IP restriction are adjacent controls, not scoped permissions, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can mint scoped or read-only API credentials so an agent or contractor can read analytics without the power to send
